notes.title: Release of Dungeon & Derision!
notes.notes:
Dungeon & Derision is now on sale!
The version 1.0.0 is now playable, explore the island, fight some hideous enemies with your team, and, the most important thing, have fun!

Stay tuned for more information about the future updates on my discord server https://discord.gg/spE95dE !

notes.title: Beta version 0.11 is now live !
notes.notes:
The version 0.11 is now live, here's the modification :

New areas, the forest and the village, that can replace the cimetery and crypt
New events in every area of the game
New succes
The interface of the map is generated differently, so you shouldn't have 2 map tiles overlapping, this also concern the demo !

notes.title: Beta version 0.10 now live !
notes.notes:
The version 0.10 is now live, here's a recap of what's new :


 A new area, the swamp, is replacing the farm. In a future version, the area will either be the farm or the swamp, but for now, only the swamp is available to test the new monsters and loots !
 Add an easy mode where your heroes ressurct and bring back to full life after a battle, so you can play without worrying about your heroes !
 On the first fight, some indications appear to understand the mechanics
 New items on merchants !
 And from the version 0.9 : a new hero is available, the shepherd !
 Some bug fixes


The demo is update as well with these new features !

notes.title: Beta version 0.8
notes.notes:
Beta version 0.8 is now live !
What changed ?

 One new monster per area with new equipments
 Spells damage ratio are now mixed but every hero have a main ratio
 For example, the wizard will always have an intelligence ratio on every spells but some of them will also have a dexterity or a strength ratio, you can check this on the character sheet

 And finally two new events

If you find bugs, you can report it on the discord server : https://www.discord.gg/spE95dE
